integrity: Analytic argument uses Mittag-Leffler kernel asymptotics, half-plane Phragmen-Lindelof, Jensen subharmonic mean, and exact Gaussian change of variables; finite checks do not certify the analytic steps.
scientific_limitations: Classification is only for same-space one-variable radial powers and nonzero affine translations of unit slope. The published boundedness criterion and Gaussian multiplier branch are antecedents; the new deduction is the all-entire-weight phase classification. Independent audit not performed.
title: The sharp radial-growth trichotomy for entire weighted translations on power Fock spaces
